description: This file contains extension methods for configuring dependency injection in an Orleans.Serialization utility project, specifically adding existing service registrations to an IServiceCollection.

classes.name: InternalServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for IServiceCollection to register services based on existing registrations.

methods.name: AddFromExisting
methods.description: Registers an existing registration of a service implementation type as a provider for a specified service type, based on previous registrations.

methods.name: AddFromExisting
methods.description: Registers an existing registration by Type objects for the specified service and implementation types, cloning the registration for reuse.
